title: Title & Deed Fraud Detection

blueprintSignals.name: Ownership change speed
blueprintSignals.definition: days between the first filing and the transfer to a new owner or a loan against the property
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Legitimate rushed sales exist, so combine with other signals

blueprintSignals.name: Notary frequency
blueprintSignals.definition: number of filings by the same notary in the last 30 days compared with their norm
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Busy notaries are legitimate, so compare with their norm

blueprintSignals.name: Vacant or no-mortgage property
blueprintSignals.definition: flag for property that is vacant or has no mortgage

blueprintSignals.name: Signature similarity
blueprintSignals.definition: similarity score of the signature against previous filings by the owner
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Image quality and ageing change signatures, so use a threshold with a review

label: For "Title & Deed Fraud Detection": Detect forged deeds, owner impersonation and suspicious transfers before closing or recording. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Few labelled cases and many undetected ones make the recall unknowable.
